name: Mashikaku
introduction: Mashikaku is an artist duo comprising of Masato Yamaguchi and Yoshiyuki Kano: the former’s commissioned expertise as a graphic designer and an art director since the early 2000s has had a wide scope of objects from advertisement, web to products, which evolved to creating his own pieces by the second half of 2010s, while the latter has entirely been renowned for his signature Zetsuei fonts. They have been presenting artworks pursuing strong aesthetics in squares and an identity as Japanese based on Mashikaku (Regular Squares), the Chinese character typefaces they developed.
